Based on the image provided, here is the evaluation of the expanded drink category overlay:

1.  **Is the expanded overlay visible?**
    **Yes.** The "Hot Drinks" category button has been clicked, and a light-colored, rounded rectangular overlay is clearly visible on top of it.

2.  **Does the full category name appear on ONE HORIZONTAL LINE?**
    **Yes.** The text "Hot Drinks" is displayed in full on a single horizontal line within the center of the overlay.

3.  **CRITICAL: Is the expanded overlay positioned WITHIN the screen bounds (not cut off on the right edge)? Does it stay close to where the original button was, or does it drift far to the right?**
    **No, it is NOT fully within the screen bounds.** The right edge of the expanded overlay appears to be cut off by the edge of the screen/image frame. While it stays relatively close to the original button's position, it expands too far to the right to fit entirely within the visible area.

4.  **Is the 'Tap again to select' hint visible?**
    **Yes.** A small white tooltip containing the text "Tap again to select" is visible just below and slightly to the right of the expanded overlay.
